chunks: And Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa al-Yaqtini who said:
When people differed regarding the matter of Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), I collected from his questions, those that were asked of him and he answered, fifteen thousand questions.

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا: Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (Imam Ali ibn Musa)

ai.seo_question: How many questions did Abdullah ibn Ja'far collect from Imam al-Rida regarding his Imamate?
ai.summary: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari narrates that to resolve sectarian disputes regarding the Imamate of Imam al-Rida (a.s.), he compiled fifteen thousand questions and answers, a massive corpus known as *al-Masa'il al-Khamsa wa-l-Alf*. This compilation serves as a crucial scholarly tool for establishing the Imam's theological authority and clarifying doctrinal nuances in the face of competing claims. The sheer volume underscores the Imam's role as the definitive interpreter of divine law during a period of intense intellectual and political contestation.
